# Marky v1.8.8

A fix for Git sync over SSH with a passphrase-protected key on Windows.

### Git sync

- Fixed the Windows askpass helper mangling SSH key passphrases that contain `%`, `&`, `|`, `<`, `>`, `(`, `)`, `"` or `^`. Those characters are syntax to the Windows command interpreter, so a passphrase using any of them was either truncated or rejected, and `&` in particular caused the rest of the passphrase to be run as a command. Passphrases are now escaped before the helper echoes them.
- A passphrase of exactly `off`, or one with a leading space, is now passed through intact.

macOS and Linux were unaffected — their askpass helper already quoted the passphrase correctly.
